cases.sentence: Ему, видимо, трудно было сообразить, что сказать и сделать. – Вот видишь ли… – Он указал в углу комнаты какие-то ___, завязанные бечевками. – Видишь ли это?
cases.explain: «железные бруски» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It was obviously difficult for him to think of what to say and do. “Here, do you see?” … He pointed to some sort of iron bars, fastened together with strings, lying in a corner of the room. “Do you see that? That’s the beginning of a new thing we’re going into. It’s a productive association. …”

cases.sentence: Это начало ___, к которому мы приступаем.
cases.explain: «нового дела» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It was obviously difficult for him to think of what to say and do. “Here, do you see?” … He pointed to some sort of iron bars, fastened together with strings, lying in a corner of the room. “Do you see that? That’s the beginning of a new thing we’re going into. It’s a productive association. …”

cases.sentence: – Ты знаешь, что капитал давит работника, – работники у нас, мужики, несут всю тягость труда и поставлены так, что, сколько бы они ни трудились, они не могут выйти из своего ___.
cases.explain: «скотского положения» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “You know that capital oppresses the laborer. The laborers with us, the peasants, bear all the burden of labor, and are so placed that however much they work they can’t escape from their position of beasts of burden. All the profits of labor, on which they might improve their position, and gain leisure for themselves, and after that education, all the surplus values are taken from them by the capitalists. And society’s so constituted that the harder they work, the greater the profit of the merchants and landowners, while they stay beasts of burden to the end. And that state of things must be changed,” he finished up, and he looked questioningly at his brother.

cases.sentence: Все барыши ___, на которые они могли бы улучшить свое положение, доставить себе досуг и вследствие этого образование, все излишки платы – отнимаются у них капиталистами.
cases.explain: «заработной платы» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.

cases.sentence: – Да, разумеется, – сказал Константин, вглядываясь в румянец, выступивший под ___ щек брата.
cases.explain: «выдающимися костями» — after the preposition «под», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Yes, of course,” said Konstantin, looking at the patch of red that had come out on his brother’s projecting cheekbones.

cases.sentence: Ты неправ более ___, а он более внутренно.
cases.explain: «внешним образом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: This timidity touched Konstantin. “If you want to hear my confession of faith on the subject, I tell you that in your quarrel with Sergey Ivanovitch I take neither side. You’re both wrong. You’re more wrong externally, and he inwardly.”

cases.sentence: Боже мой, что это за бессмыслица на свете! – вдруг вскрикнул он. – Эти ___, эти мировые судьи, земство, что это за безобразие!
cases.explain: «новые учреждения» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Only you mustn’t be polite and stiff with her. It frightens her. No one ever spoke to her so but the justices of the peace who tried her for trying to get out of a house of ill-fame. Mercy on us, the senselessness in the world!” he cried suddenly. “These new institutions, these justices of the peace, rural councils, what hideousness it all is!”

cases.sentence: И он начал рассказывать свои столкновения с ___.
cases.explain: «новыми учреждениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: And he began to enlarge on his encounters with the new institutions.

cases.sentence: Константин Левин слушал его, и то отрицание смысла во всех ___, которое он разделял с ним и часто высказывал, было ему неприятно теперь из уст брата.
cases.explain: «общественных учреждениях» — after the preposition «во», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Konstantin Levin heard him, and the disbelief in the sense of all public institutions, which he shared with him, and often expressed, was distasteful to him now from his brother’s lips.

cases.sentence: Знаешь, я очень полюбил цыган и ___.
cases.explain: «русские песни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “In another world! Ah, I don’t like that other world! I don’t like it,” he said, letting his scared eyes rest on his brother’s eyes. “Here one would think that to get out of all the baseness and the mess, one’s own and other people’s, would be a good thing, and yet I’m afraid of death, awfully afraid of death.” He shuddered. “But do drink something. Would you like some champagne? Or shall we go somewhere? Let’s go to the Gypsies! Do you know I have got so fond of the Gypsies and Russian songs.”
